Premium prices, poor transparency, and disappointing service
Apr 2026 • Couples
A disappointing end to what had been a nice evening. The menu prices were not the true prices. there was an added 7% surcharge plus government taxes, which increased the final bill by around 25%, and no one had the courtesy to mention it when ordering.

For a place positioning itself as premium, transparency should be basic. To make matters worse, the table water ended up costing 231,000 VND once charges were added, which only reinforced how poor the value felt overall. What made it worse is that we’re staying at Dusit Princess, where the service has actually been quicker, friendlier, and overall better. If we’d known the real cost upfront, we would have simply stayed there for dinner instead.

Honestly, future guests would be better off going to Soi 14 at Dusit Princess instead.. the Thai food is tastier, the service is better, and it’s far better value.
